artNotes: a canyon of glass and brick skyscrapers going up out of frame
wooden water towers on the rooftops
black iron fire escapes zigzagging down the buildings
a dog walker holding six leads at once

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in New York!
completeText.he: מצאתם את {name} שלוש פעמים בניו יורק!

artComposition: Keep the elevated angle over the crowd, but make the SKYLINE dominate: a canyon of very tall skyscrapers fills the whole upper half on both sides and recedes into the distance, so the city is unmistakable at a glance. Water towers on the roofs, fire escapes down the brick fronts, a steel suspension bridge far behind. The street below is a wide crossing with yellow taxis.

tagline.en: The tower above a great square, a carousel and warm bread.
tagline.he: המגדל מעל כיכר גדולה, קרוסלה ולחם חם.

item.en: a bakery window full of baguettes and pastries

success.en: You found me! Want a bite?

placement.support: Both feet on the plaza paving just outside the bakery, behind the low flowers.
placement.occlusion: Only the existing low flower baskets may hide the lower legs; the entire face is above the flowers.
placement.instructions: A small school-age child peeks out beside the bakery flower display. Stay out of the glass pastry cabinet. Preserve every existing person, flower, pastry and frame. Do not extend another person's body. Plan a complete standing body behind the low flowers.

hintText.en: Look by the bakery window.
Look by the second shop.

targets.action: The child stands on the wooden carousel deck between the poles, watching the horses. Both shoes rest on TOP of the deck and the entire body rises above it. Do not put a head or torso through the deck, under a horse, or in the floor. Use an existing pole only as a narrow natural overlap, never as an excuse to erase the legs.

item.en: a carousel with painted horses

success.en: You found me! One more ride?

placement.support: Both shoes rest on TOP of the wooden carousel deck in the gap between the two horses.
placement.occlusion: A narrow existing vertical carousel pole can overlap a shoulder, never the face; do not hide the body with the deck.
placement.instructions: Show a complete small child between the horses, not riding or fused into a horse. The child is at the depth of the riders but below their seated heads. Preserve the horses, poles and children waiting OUTSIDE the carousel. The lower edge of the deck must stay below the child's feet, not across their waist.

hintText.en: Look at the carousel.
Look at the other side of the carousel.

targets.action: The child stands on the stone paving under the striped cafe awning, peeking around the edge of the cafe doorframe. The awning is overhead, NOT a surface a child is inside. Keep the body connected from face to shoes on the paving; only an actual existing table or doorframe may cover part of it. Do not blend the legs into the pavement or another person's body.

item.en: café tables under striped awnings

success.en: A little spot in the shade!
You found me! The chairs are tiny.

placement.support: Both shoes on the open stone pavement between the cafe chairs and the fruit cart.
placement.occlusion: No occlusion needed: keep the whole small standing body visible, with clear separation from the existing adults.
placement.instructions: The child is visiting the cafe, standing in the narrow open paved aisle. Keep the head below the nearby adults' shoulders at the same depth. Do not sit in the occupied chair, replace a diner, stand on the umbrella, or paint a floating head into the awning.

hintText.en: Look beside the café tables.
Look at the café on the right.

artNotes: the Eiffel tower large and complete in the middle of the picture
a wide stone plaza in front of it, full of tiny people
a carousel with painted horses at one edge of the plaza
a bakery window full of baguettes and pastries
artists painting at easels facing the tower
flower boxes on every balcony around the square

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Paris!

reaction.en: Excuse me, that is a hat!

artComposition: The Eiffel Tower is the subject: draw it LARGE and complete, from its four feet to its tip, standing in the middle of the picture at the far side of a wide open plaza. It should be the first thing anyone sees. The plaza in front of it is full of tiny people, with the carousel, the bakery and the café tables around its edges.

artNotes: walls of glowing neon signs in pink, blue, green and gold
the wet street reflecting the neon in long colourful streaks

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in Tokyo!

artComposition: NIGHT, not daylight: this one is lit by neon. Towers of glowing signs in pink, blue, green and gold cover the buildings on every side and reflect in the wet street below, and paper lanterns glow orange over the festival stalls. Keep it bright and colourful — the neon does the work the sun does elsewhere. The cherry blossom stays, lit pink by the signs above it.

tagline.en: Endless steps, a paper dragon and mist on the hills.
tagline.he: מדרגות אינסופיות, דרקון נייר וערפל על הגבעות.

wardrobe: a thin light-blue shirt and sand-coloured trousers

item.he: דרקון נייר ארוך שילדים רבים נושאים

You found me! He is very long.

targets.action: The child is standing on the wall, looking up at the red lantern.
targets.expression: curious, looking up at the lantern, mouth relaxed

item.en: red lanterns strung between poles along the wall

placement.support: Both feet on the open paved walkway behind the nearest hanging red lantern, between the seated visitors and the pole.
placement.occlusion: Keep the complete body visible. The nearby low wall can overlap a shoe only, never the face or torso.
placement.instructions: A school-age child stands watching a red lantern, separated from the seated visitors on the left and standing visitors on the right. The dragon parade is FARTHER BACK; do not put this child on, inside or attached to the dragon. Preserve every existing person and lantern. Use the small child's height at this foreground depth, not the height of the older visitors.

hintText.en: Look by the red lanterns.
Look at the lanterns further along.
